label: Simulation signatures
subgoals: Simulate random vectors and record each node's signature
Group nodes with identical signatures into classes
Count the classes that have at least two members

label: Proving candidates with SAT
subgoals: Pick a representative for each class
Charge one SAT call per non-representative member
Feed failing calls' counterexamples back into simulation

label: Equivalence up to complement
subgoals: Normalize each signature up to complement
Count the classes with at least two members, mixing phases
